announcements.headline: Post-Stabilization Notice ING Bank
announcements.insight: This is a standard administrative notice confirming the conclusion of a post-issue stabilization period for ING Bank N.V., indicating no further price support actions will be taken; it carries no fundamental strategic weight or material financial implication for the issuer.
